prompt: "Write a behavior tree for the robot to execute the command using only available nodes. Approach, take object. Check properties. If OK, perform task, else approach object or scan area. list of available nodes: <Action ID = ApproachObject    /> <Action ID = TakeObject    /> <Condition ID = AreObjectPropertiesAppropriate    /> <SubTree ID = PerformTask    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectVisible    /> <Action ID = ScanAreaForObject    />"
code:
SEQUENCE
			IF IsObjectApproached? THEN
			DO TakeObject
	ELSE
			IF AreObjectPropertiesAppropriate? THEN
			DO PerformTask
	END
